title: docs(changeset): date the two rotted present-tense declaration claims in the kanban pending entries
body:
Fixes #9713

Clause-②: no — no declaration, accept set or requiredness moves. Prose only, in two
pending `.changeset/*.md` bodies; both frontmatters are byte-identical.

## What was false, and which defect each site is

⭐ The card's own distinction, applied to every site **before** it was touched.

### `.changeset/8802-8257-8008-kanban-gantt-family-retirement.md` — BOTH defects in one sentence

The sentence «The surviving `ObjectKanbanSchema` face declares none of them» was written
at `adf581278` (2026-09-10T09:59:59Z, PR objectui#8865). The keys "them" refers to are the
twelve named in the two clauses just above it, plus a lane's `cards`.

| key | on `ObjectKanbanSchema` at `adf581278` | on `origin/main` `bbba09840` | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | not declared | declared | **ROTTED** — objectui#8913 (PR objectui#8989, `8693b8569`, 2026-09-10T16:32Z), six and a half hours later |
| `cardTitle` | not declared | declared | **ROTTED** — objectui#9606 (PR objectui#9709, `78a9c6744`, 2026-09-17T18:36Z) |
| `titleField` | **declared** (`z.string().optional()`) | declared | **BORN FALSE** |
| `allowCollapse` | **declared** (`z.boolean().optional()`, live) | declared, as a `retirementTombstone()` | **BORN FALSE** |
| `swimlaneField`, `grouping`, `navigation`, `cardTemplates`, `columnWidths`, `draggable`, `onColumnAdd`, `onCardAdd`, `cards` | not declared | not declared | true throughout |

⇒ ⭐ **The card recorded this site as rot. It is rot AND birth defect at once**, and the
two halves need opposite repairs, so the repair states both rather than picking one.
`titleField` and `allowCollapse` appear in the sentence's *refused-by-name* clause — that
clause is true, the surviving face does not refuse them — but it declares both, which is
what «declares none of them» denied, on the day it was written.

Ordering is proved, not inferred: `git merge-base --is-ancestor adf581278 8693b8569` and
`… adf581278 78a9c674` both **exit 0**. An exit 0 is self-certifying on a shallow checkout
(it names a real ancestry path); the repository was deepened to 2072 commits first and the
two write commits were re-read from that history.

### `.changeset/7322-object-kanban-component-props.md` — five readings, all ROTTED

Written at `6ca6e12a7` (2026-09-06T21:13Z, PR objectui#8153). `git merge-base --is-ancestor
6ca6e12a7 X` exits 0 for every one of the five falsifying commits.

| reading | measured at `6ca6e12a7` | measured on `bbba09840` | falsified by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| registered under two node type keys; `KanbanSchema` is a declared node type | true | `KanbanSchema` is gone; the prop is one arm again | objectui#8802 (`adf581278`) |
| `objectName` REQUIRED | `z.string()` | `z.string().optional()` | objectui#7780 (PR objectui#8412, `786bc91ea`) |
| `groupBy` REQUIRED | `z.string()` | `z.string().optional()` | objectui#8990 (PR objectui#9021, `a4b723fab`) |
| `filter` declared by NEITHER face | true | declared on `ObjectKanbanSchema` | objectui#8174 (PR objectui#8788, `ee4d19f6c`) |
| `columns`, `cardTitle` — `KanbanSchema` only | true | both on `ObjectKanbanSchema` | objectui#8913, objectui#9606 |

⛔ Not touched, and the reason is measured rather than assumed: line 47's «`cardTitle`
(already declared; the casts were redundant)» is a **past-tense** statement about the
retired arm and is still correct — the card warned that the two look alike and only one
moves. `titleField` — `ObjectKanbanSchema` only, and `navigation` declared on neither face,
both still read true and are left alone.

## The repair shape, and why it is not an overwrite

Per the card's fix order: **the construction that permits the error is the undated
present-tense sentence about another file's current state.** Both repairs delete that
construction rather than re-running it — every restated reading carries the date it was
taken and the card that moved it, so it can be re-derived from its own words and cannot
rot a second time. No gate was added; none is proposed here.

## ⚙ Anchors, re-taken — the readings above are ref-stable across three heads of `main`

⚠️ `origin/main` moved three times while this was being measured: `4cf57b6da` →
`95f7e4c3d` (objectui#9719, objectui#9720) → `bbba09840` (objectui#9712). **The third move
landed between this seat's `git fetch` and its `git merge origin/main` — `refs/remotes/*`
is shared across worktrees, so a sibling's fetch advances it under you.** The merge was
taken, is clean and additive, and left both edited entries untouched
(`git diff eae77bd91 HEAD -- ` the two paths is empty).

Every reading in the tables above was then re-taken on `95f7e4c3d`, on `bbba09840` and on
this branch's own head, with the same script each time. All four readings are **identical**:
`columns` / `cardTitle` / `titleField` / `filter` declared, `allowCollapse` a
`retirementTombstone()`, `objectName` and `groupBy` optional, and `KanbanSchema` at **0**
export definitions against a lit control of **3** for `ObjectKanbanSchema` on the same
instrument, same corpus, same rev. ⭐ A ref that is two merges stale would be exactly the
defect this card exists to repair, so the anchor is named rather than assumed.

## ⚠️ One site deliberately NOT repaired — it is neither ROTTED nor BORN FALSE

`8802-…` names `packages/types/src/complex.ts` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx`,
which the in-flight draft PR objectui#9721 edits; that PR's own claim-re-read gate comment
reports the overlap. Measured against objectui#9721's live diff: it changes `describe`
text, the `allowCollapse` tombstone message and the `KanbanColumn.collapsed` doc comment,
and it **adds and removes no member** on either `ObjectKanbanSchema` face. So no sentence
this PR repairs depends on it. ⭐ A sentence that is true today and would be falsified only
once objectui#9721 lands is a **third** state — not yet false — and belongs to that PR, not
to this one. **None was found in the two entries here, and the search was specific**: the
only lane-collapse claim anywhere in either entry is `allowCollapse`, which objectui#9721
keeps as a `retirementTombstone()` and only re-words the refusal message of — so the
BORN FALSE row above stays true after that PR lands, in the window between the two merges
as well as after. The check is recorded because the absence is the result, not a skipped
step.

⛔ objectui#9721 is in the merge queue as this is written. File-level disjointness was
re-taken against its live file list, not against any table handed to this seat: it touches
`.changeset/9628-kanban-column-collapsed-honoured.md` and
`.changeset/8801-object-kanban-allow-collapse-retired.md`, neither of which is edited here.
All thirteen other open pull requests were enumerated and their `.changeset/` files read off
their own file lists; none names either entry this PR edits.

## Measurement — instruments, corpus, controls

⚠️ Every prose query is **whitespace-tolerant**: each body is read with its frontmatter
stripped and every whitespace run collapsed to a single space **before** matching, because
changeset prose wraps near eighty columns and a line-anchored matcher is blind to a
sentence that wraps. POSIX ERE has no `\s`, so no `grep -E` was used for prose at all.

**Instrument P — the derived list.** DOMAIN: 15628 sentences across all **1639** pending
entries. PREDICATE: the sentence names a schema symbol AND carries a **present-tense**
declaration verb (`declares` / `declare` / `is|are declared`). ⛔ Bare past `declared` is
excluded — a past-tense sentence is historical and cannot rot, which is the `7322:47`
distinction above. Reading: **199 sentences across 169 entries**. Controls, same instrument
and same corpus: lit — 502 entries match the present-tense verb at all; dark — 0 entries
contain a nonsense token.

**Instrument V — mechanical polarity check.** DOMAIN: instrument P's sentences. PREDICATE:
for each (schema S with a member set built from `packages/types/src`, backticked key K) in
one sentence, is K a member of S? Controls: lit — `ObjectKanbanSchema` has `columns` (true);
dark — it has `zzqq` (false). Reading: **154 candidate contradictions across 53 entries**.

⛔ **V's 53 are candidates, not verdicts, and saying so is part of the reading.** Spot
review shows a high false-positive rate: the sentence window pairs a schema and a key that
are not predicated of each other, and keys declared by `@objectstack/spec` rather than by
this repo read as absent. ⚠️ V also **misses** the `8802-…` site entirely — that sentence's
object is the pronoun «them», resolved across a sentence boundary, and no regex reaches it.
⇒ two zeros are never read as an absence here; both entries repaired in this PR were
reached by reading the files.

**Declared narrowing.** What is repaired here is the sub-class the card names and this seat
verified by hand — present-tense claims about what the kanban family declares. The 53-entry
candidate list is reported to the dispatching seat rather than swept in this PR: each one
needs the ROTTED / BORN-FALSE adjudication that must precede any touch, and that is per-site
work, not a batch edit.

## Frontmatter, proved on both refs

| entry | frontmatter sha256 on `origin/main` | in this branch | bytes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `8802-8257-8008-kanban-gantt-family-retirement.md` | `9f8dbee7965ce7e2554d3485936677648d200e0ba569000bbbd19594a0951f53` | identical | 243 |
| `7322-object-kanban-component-props.md` | `bf9e59f968146504cb73c7508541747c555a82ca18f046bd3aa3f5138bc59380` | identical | 42 |

`check-changeset-overwrite`'s documented case 2: a pre-existing entry modified for prose
only, every declared package name kept.

## Gates

All nine green, re-run on the merged head `ed2ab5078`; each exit code captured to a file
**before** any pipe, each printed verdict line quoted in the gate comment on this thread.
